# British Education and Immigration

> Premier study visa consultancy and IELTS / PTE coaching institute based in Sangaria, Hanumangarh, Rajasthan, India. Specialising in student visa guidance for Canada, the United Kingdom, Australia, the United States, New Zealand, and Europe.

## Organization Details
- **Official Name**: British Education & Immigration
- **Address**: Near Open Book Library, Bhagatpura Road, Sangaria, Rajasthan 335063, India
- **Coordinates**: 29.798547, 74.464214
- **Primary Phone**: +91 96580 18000
- **Secondary Phone**: +91 97725 70478
- **Email**: admissions@britisheducationandimmigration.com
- **Website**: https://www.britisheducationandimmigration.com
- **Office Hours**: Monday to Saturday, 09:30 AM – 07:30 PM IST (Closed Sundays)

## Core Services

### 1. Study Visa Consultancy
- Comprehensive profile evaluation, university and course selection.
- Provincial Attestation Letter (PAL) guidance for Canada study permits.
- Genuine Student (GS) assessment and SOP drafting for Australia.
- UK CAS preparation and Graduate Route (post-study work) planning.
- USA F-1 interview preparation and DS-160 documentation.
- Transparent financial documentation and GIC/blocked account assistance.

### 2. English Language Proficiency Coaching
- **IELTS (Academic & General)**: Regular & intensive batches targeting Band 7.5+. Daily speaking practice and weekly mock tests.
- **PTE Academic**: Pearson-certified syllabus, computer lab practice with automated AI scoring feedback targeting 65+ score.
- Morning and evening batches tailored for high school and university students.
